findings.issue: No test suite of any kind: no test script, no devDependencies, no test files.
findings.suggestion: Add node:test (zero new deps) covering api.js helpers, sortedRows, buildMovesData ordering and the Hono app via app.request(); wire it to a 'test' script.

findings.issue: URL template appends a trailing slash after the query string, producing '?limit=100000/'; it works only because the local API's parseInt is lenient.
findings.suggestion: Build URLs with new URL()/URLSearchParams and add a unit test asserting apiFetch('pokemon-species/?limit=100000') yields a well-formed query.

findings.issue: Missing-values-sort-last is enforced by early returns that bypass the direction sign; a refactor applying the sign uniformly would put nulls first when descending.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test ascending and descending sorts over rows containing null power/accuracy, asserting nulls last in both.

findings.issue: Latest-English-flavor-text logic is duplicated inline here and exported from api.js:46-51; the two can diverge.
findings.suggestion: Delete the inline IIFE and use latestEnglishFlavor from api.js; add a unit test with \n/\f whitespace and mixed languages.

findings.issue: Method-ordering comparator relies on a 99 sentinel and a compound condition; subtle and untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract a pure methodOrder(list) helper and unit-test Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor first, others alphabetical.

findings.issue: Ability 'non-hidden entry wins' dedup encoded as the boolean pun existing.hidden && entry.is_hidden; fragile under refactor.
findings.suggestion: Write it explicitly (skip if existing && !existing.hidden) and cover with a unit test using hidden+normal duplicates.

findings.issue: buildIndex trusts ?limit=100000 and ignores the list's 'next' cursor; alternate-form exclusion works only implicitly via byId misses.
findings.suggestion: Follow pagination cursors and add a test asserting species count matches the API total and IDs stay <=1025.

findings.issue: onError renders the Not-found page markup with HTTP 500; the error path is untested and conflates errors with 404s.
findings.suggestion: Render a distinct error page (or 500 with retry copy) and add a test forcing an upstream failure.

findings.issue: Artwork falls back to a hardcoded URL pattern even when the API explicitly returned null, hiding missing-data signals.
findings.suggestion: Respect the API value and render a placeholder when null; unit-test the fallback.

findings.issue: htmx empty-param stripping (the only thing keeping pushed URLs clean of default filters) is verified only by the acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Cover the '/' fragment endpoint via app.request() with an HX-Request header asserting query params are omitted, and a small DOM test for the configRequest hook.

summary: The app ships with no tests of its own: no test script, no runner, no test files anywhere in app/. That's a real cost here because the code is otherwise clean and pure-function-shaped — sorting invariants, moves-table assembly, index building and URL construction would all be cheap to pin down and are exactly where a refactor would silently break. At minimum, add a node:test suite for api.js helpers, sortedRows and the Hono routes via app.request().
